title: AutoPay Addition on Credit Builder Accounts Goodwill Credits
content:
The goodwill share applied to a Credit Builder late fee grows when the account is enrolled in AutoPay, more so when no payment on it has been returned recently. Enrollment is read from the account record; returns from the account's returned-payment entries, whatever their code, by their dates.

## AutoPay standing

When the account is enrolled in AutoPay and no payment on it was returned in the 3 whole calendar months before today (a return dated today counts, and one dated on the same day of the month 3 months earlier falls outside them), the clean AutoPay addition is added; when it is enrolled in AutoPay and one or more payments were returned in those months, the AutoPay addition; when it is not enrolled, nothing is added for AutoPay.

| Enrolled in AutoPay | Payments returned in the 3 months | Added to the goodwill share |
|---|---|---|
| yes | none | clean AutoPay addition: 0.05 (5 percentage points) |
| yes | one or more | AutoPay addition: 0.02 (2 percentage points) |
| no | any | nothing |

## Edge of the 3 months (hypothetical dates)

Today 14 August: a return dated 14 May falls outside the 3 months; one dated 15 May is counted.
